generation.stdout:
All acceptance requirements pass. Verification results:

| Requirement | Result |
|---|---|
| 1. Deterministic non-empty dataset (≥2 regions, ≥3 categories, ≥6 months) | ✅ 4 regions, 5 categories, 8 months, 160 points |
| 2. Exactly four populated KPI cards (revenue, orders, AOV, profit/margin) | ✅ `$1.65M`, `23,380`, `$71`, `$496.4k (30.1%)` |
| 3. Four populated charts (line, bars, donut, scatter) | ✅ line (8 pts), bars (5), donut (4 segments + legend), scatter (160) |
| 4. Region/category/period filters update KPIs + charts | ✅ Region=North, Category=Toys, Range Mar–Jun all changed the view |
| 5. Refresh button generates a different dataset, updates all | ✅ seed changed, KPIs changed |
| 6. Hover tooltips on chart marks | ✅ verified on line dot |
| 7. No JS errors + meaningful data visible on load | ✅ 0 errors, data shown immediately |

The dashboard is built entirely with inline SVG and vanilla JS — no external assets or libraries. The PRNG is seeded deterministically so each dataset is reproducible, and Refresh reseeds to produce a genuinely different one.

`artifact.html` is written to `/home/ubuntu/deepseek-activation/docs/results/eval-v7-max-effort/runs/hy3/dashboard/artifact.html`. I left a `verify.js` helper in the same directory for the puppeteer-based end-to-end check; let me know if you'd like it removed.
